feed.title: AwesomeCUA: newly reviewed resources
feed.subtitle: Computer-use agent papers, models, datasets, benchmarks and tools as they pass source review, newest review first. Metadata-only bibliography records and unreviewed candidates are not included.
feed.rights: Catalog annotations: MIT. Linked resources keep their own terms.

entry.title: AndroidWorld-SeeAct-V
entry.summary: AndroidWorld-SeeAct-V runs a visual Android agent that plans the next action and grounds coordinate actions in screenshots. The repository includes code for AndroidWorld evaluation.

entry.title: Dreamer-7B-Shopping
entry.summary: A shopping-domain Dreamer-7B checkpoint for WebDreamer, which uses screenshot-conditioned predictions of candidate web actions to support agent planning.

entry.title: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
entry.summary: An instruction-tuned vision-language checkpoint that reads visual layouts, localizes points or boxes, and supports computer and phone use. Its card reports screen and mobile-agent evaluations.

entry.title: GUI-Actor-Verifier-2B
entry.summary: A GUI grounding verifier that checks whether a marked screenshot position matches an instruction and provides a score for candidate action positions.

entry.title: HobbyLM-1B Computer Use
entry.summary: An on-device LoRA adapter that turns English requests and Mac state into single actions executed by a companion app, with training code and evaluation records.

entry.title: Jedi-3B-1080p
entry.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-3B-based computer-use grounding checkpoint with an example that predicts mouse-action coordinates from an interface image.

entry.title: Muse-Glimmer-30B-GUI-Grounding-Fast
entry.summary: A LoRA adapter for Muse-Glimmer-30B that returns a UI element's bounding box from a screenshot and instruction, with examples spanning desktop, mobile, and web screens.

entry.title: Process Discovery
entry.summary: An enterprise process-discovery product that captures activity across desktops and web apps, then maps workflows to identify patterns and automation opportunities.

entry.title: Hronaut
entry.summary: A local browser workspace for agents, exposed through MCP. It supports isolated task sessions, visible browser use and reconnection to existing tabs.

entry.title: OpenCUA-7B
entry.summary: A Qwen2.5-VL-based computer-use checkpoint that produces desktop actions from screenshots and instructions, using recent screen history for context.

entry.title: AGI-0 Agent
entry.summary: AGI-0 uses screenshots to navigate Android apps, planning subtasks and checking screen changes after each action. Its publisher reports AndroidWorld results.

entry.title: Browser Use SDKs
entry.summary: Python and TypeScript SDKs connect applications to Browser Use Cloud agents and managed browsers for browser task execution and control.

entry.title: DroidBot
entry.summary: DroidBot generates scripted or model-guided inputs for Android app testing and records UI transitions, view structures, and method traces.

entry.title: Firecrawl MCP Server
entry.summary: An MCP server for Firecrawl that gives agents web search and extraction tools plus browser interaction for clicking, typing, filling forms, and navigation.

entry.title: GTA1-7B-2507
entry.summary: GTA1-7B-2507 is a GUI-grounding checkpoint trained with reinforcement learning to locate described elements in screenshots and return click coordinates.

entry.title: Holo4-27B-NVFP4
entry.summary: A quantized Holo4 vision-language checkpoint for computer use across web, desktop, and mobile interfaces, with a harness that executes requested GUI and tool actions.

entry.title: UI-Ins-7B
entry.summary: UI-Ins-7B is a GUI-grounding checkpoint trained on varied instruction formulations and reinforcement learning to locate interface elements for agent actions.

entry.title: Llama8b-NNetNav-WA
entry.summary: A Llama checkpoint trained on demonstrations gathered through WebArena exploration. It takes a task instruction and selects browser actions to navigate webpages.

entry.title: McGill-NLP/safearena
entry.summary: SafeArena supplies safe and harmful task splits for evaluating the safety of autonomous web agents, with accompanying environment archives under gated access.

entry.title: WebRL-GLM-4-9B
entry.summary: A GLM-based WebRL model released for browser tasks across five WebArena websites. Its card reports evaluation results on WebArena-Lite.

entry.title: BearCubs
entry.summary: A live-web benchmark with 111 questions testing agents' ability to browse and extract factual answers through text and multimodal interactions.

entry.title: Browser MCP
entry.summary: A local MCP server and Chromium extension that let AI applications operate browser tabs through Playwright, with pairing and extension-enforced controls.

entry.title: GERALLT
entry.summary: An LLM-driven system for testing RCE through its graphical interface, using separate models to control actions, assess problems, and describe icons.

entry.title: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-GGUF
entry.summary: A quantized Holo3.1 vision-language checkpoint for computer-use agents across web, desktop, and mobile interfaces, with UI grounding and function calling.

entry.title: Qwen3-VL-8B-Thinking
entry.summary: A general vision-language weight release whose documented visual-agent capability includes recognizing PC and mobile GUI elements and invoking tools to complete tasks.

entry.title: CLYRedNote
entry.summary: An Android Compose clone app for GUI-agent testing, with shopping, messaging, search, and content screens backed by seeded fictional data.

entry.title: GBOX MCP + Claude Code
entry.summary: An AndroidWorld benchmark setup that connects a Claude agent to an Android emulator through GBOX MCP and includes a task-completion tool for evaluation.

entry.title: Hyperbrowser MCP Server
entry.summary: An MCP server that exposes Hyperbrowser web tools and browser-agent actions, including Browser Use and computer-use agents, through a single tool interface.

entry.title: lumos_web_agent_plan_iterative
entry.summary: A Lumos-Iterative dataset for training a web agent's planning module, with 1009 Mind2Web task annotations in the described data overview.

entry.title: SpiritSight-Agent-2B
entry.summary: A 2B vision-based GUI agent checkpoint for interface navigation across GUI platforms, released with an inference script and base-model information.

entry.title: ego lite
entry.summary: ego lite is a desktop browser that gives agents separate browsing Spaces and exposes page snapshots and actions through the ego-browser integration.

entry.title: GPA-GUI-Detector
entry.summary: GPA-GUI-Detector is a YOLO model that locates interactive elements such as buttons and icons in interface screenshots and returns bounding boxes for automation workflows.

entry.title: OpAgent
entry.summary: OpAgent is a web-navigation agent that observes screenshots, plans and grounds actions, and executes browser operations. Its repository also includes single-model and training modes.

entry.title: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-UI-R1-E
entry.summary: Qwen2.5-VL-3B-UI-R1-E releases UI-R1-E-3B, a model that predicts click coordinates from interface screenshots and commands, with reported mobile, desktop, and web grounding evaluations.

entry.title: websrc
entry.summary: websrc is a screenshot-focused WebSRC compilation for answering questions about webpage content and structure. It provides page identifiers, questions, answers, and encoded images.

entry.title: ZeroGUI-AndroidLab-7B
entry.summary: ZeroGUI-AndroidLab-7B is a GUI-agent checkpoint associated with training that generates interface tasks, estimates rewards from screenshots, and adapts through online reinforcement learning.

entry.title: Computer Agents
entry.summary: A cloud agent platform that gives agents persistent computers with browser, GUI, terminal, and file access, alongside project workspaces and workflow triggers.

entry.title: cua-ai/cua-s1-forms
entry.summary: Training and evaluation examples for selecting GUI form actions from document content, with synthetic train, validation, and test splits plus real browser form demos.

entry.title: E2B
entry.summary: Cloud sandbox infrastructure for agents, with a Desktop SDK that exposes screenshots, mouse and keyboard control, application launch, and streaming.

entry.title: GUI Grounding Pre-training Data for SeeClick
entry.summary: A SeeClick data collection tool that uses Common Crawl URLs and Selenium to gather web pages and element grounding data for pretraining.

entry.title: inclusionAI/UI-Venus-Navi-7B
entry.summary: A released UI agent checkpoint based on Qwen2.5-VL that takes screenshots and prior actions to predict GUI navigation actions and element locations.

entry.title: KDEGroup/UI-AGILE-3B
entry.summary: A released UI-AGILE checkpoint for GUI grounding, associated with reward design and cropping based resampling during training and image decomposition during inference.

entry.title: AgentOccam
entry.summary: AgentOccam is a web agent that uses webpage descriptions and action strings to carry out tasks from a URL and instruction. Its repository includes task configurations and evaluation scripts.

entry.title: bevaya/RICO-ScreenQA-Complex
entry.summary: A test dataset of complex questions about RICO interface screens, with screen images and ground-truth answers. The card lists 11,781 examples.

entry.title: Fintor/Fintor-GUI-S2
entry.summary: Fintor-GUI-S2 is a GUI grounding checkpoint fine-tuned from UI-TARS-7B-DPO on OS-Copilot data. Its card reports ScreenSpot Pro and v2 evaluations.

entry.title: Narada Code and OperatorMini
entry.summary: Narada Code develops and tests computer-use workflows, then revises them after failures. OperatorMini executes the instructions for repeatable web and enterprise tasks.

entry.title: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
entry.summary: Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct is a vision-language checkpoint whose card describes PC and mobile GUI operation, including element recognition and tool calls.

entry.title: UniClawBench
entry.summary: UniClawBench evaluates agents on tool, browser, file, and desktop GUI workflows. Its bilingual release contains 400 tasks, Docker runtimes, and trace review tools.

entry.title: Claude Sonnet 4.6
entry.summary: A general model whose release documents computer use through visual observation, mouse actions, and keyboard input, with OSWorld evaluation and prompt-injection testing.

entry.title: ClawBench
entry.summary: A browser-agent task corpus for everyday work on live websites, with V1 and V2 test splits, task context, and schemas that intercept final submissions.

entry.title: GUI_Reflection_SFT_train
entry.summary: Offline supervised fine-tuning data for GUI Reflection, released as JSONL files. Users obtain the corresponding images from the source datasets named in the card.

entry.title: Indeed-UI
entry.summary: A GUI grounding model described for desktop, mobile, and browser interfaces. Its repository provides ScreenSpot-Pro evaluation and zoom-in scripts.

entry.title: lenovo TianXi_Action_Grounding_7B
entry.summary: An evaluation script for running a multimodal GUI grounding model on ScreenSpot-Pro, with options for instruction variants and structured result logs.

entry.title: Qwen2.5-VL
entry.summary: A general vision-language model family whose release documents visual-agent behavior for computer and phone use, alongside image and video understanding.

entry.title: TurkingBench
entry.summary: A web-agent benchmark built from crowdsourcing HTML tasks, with 32.2K instances across 158 tasks and a framework that applies model responses to page controls.

entry.title: UI-Ins-32B
entry.summary: A GUI grounding checkpoint that locates interface elements from instructions. Its training combines varied instruction formulations with reinforcement learning.

entry.title: VeriGUI
entry.summary: VeriWeb dataset of 302 web information-seeking tasks, with annotated subtasks, human action logs, and execution videos for evaluating long-chain agents.

entry.title: ZeroGUI-OSWorld-7B
entry.summary: A GUI agent checkpoint associated with ZeroGUI, which trains on generated interface tasks using rewards estimated from trajectory screenshots.

entry.title: ADP Workforce Now Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for ADP Workforce Now. It provides actions for payroll reports, pay-stub exports, employee updates and tax-form downloads.

entry.title: Holo4-35B-A3B-FP8
entry.summary: An FP8 vision-language checkpoint for computer use. With an agent harness, it processes screenshots and tool results to request clicks, typing, code and tool calls.

entry.title: SAP SuccessFactors Browser Automation
entry.summary: A browser automation scaffold for SAP SuccessFactors. It includes actions for workforce reports, employee goals, compensation worksheets and organization-chart exports.

entry.title: UiPad
entry.summary: A macOS UI dataset with 352 screens from 63 applications. It pairs screenshots with available accessibility trees and questions about interface elements and click locations.

entry.title: BugCraft
entry.summary: A vision-based agent that converts Minecraft crash reports into reproduction steps and executes them through a macro API. Its project page also describes BugCraft-Bench.

entry.title: DroidAgent
entry.summary: An Android GUI testing agent that explores an app from user goals, then generates test scenarios, replay scripts, and reports of its actions.

entry.title: microsoft/Phi-Ground-Any
entry.summary: A fine-tuned vision model that takes an image and instruction and returns a click point. Its card specifies image resizing and coordinate conversion.

entry.title: InfiGUI-G1-3B
entry.summary: A GUI grounding checkpoint based on Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct. It uses adaptive exploration training to locate interface elements from an instruction and screen image.

entry.title: pdlgen
entry.summary: A Go code generator that turns Chrome DevTools Protocol definitions into typed browser-control bindings used by chromedp and other Go programs.

entry.title: AskUI
entry.summary: AskUI runs plain-language Android app tests through visual screen interaction on devices and emulators, with screenshot traces and CI integrations.

entry.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5
entry.summary: Claude Sonnet 4.5 is a general model available through an API. Anthropic reports its computer-use performance on OSWorld and demonstrates browser tasks.

entry.title: Coasty
entry.summary: Coasty develops computer-use environments for agent training and evaluation, using computer and phone interfaces alongside trajectories and outcome checks.

entry.title: Fanbin/waa_steve_trajectories
entry.summary: A dataset of STEVE-R1 evaluation trajectories on WindowsAgentArena, pairing task screenshots and agent responses with action traces and outcome labels.

entry.title: MyInstagram
entry.summary: MyInstagram is an Android clone app with interactive social screens, mock data, and state fields for checking the outcomes of GUI agent tasks.

entry.title: WebGuard
entry.summary: Dataset of 5,999 browser-action safety annotations, pairing website and action details with risk classifications for web-agent research.

entry.title: ZonUI-3B
entry.summary: Code for training and evaluating ZonUI-3B, a GUI grounding model tested on mobile, desktop, and web screenshots at varying resolutions.

entry.title: FluidGPT
entry.summary: An Android agent that selects reusable app routines from a task goal and executes them through the accessibility tree. Its benchmark report presents episode recordings and action traces.

entry.title: webrl-llama-3.1-70b
entry.summary: A released Llama-3.1-70B WebRL model for operating five WebArena websites. Its model card reports WebArena-Lite results and points to inference requirements.

entry.title: WebTactix
entry.summary: A web agent that simplifies accessibility trees, explores candidate actions in parallel and stores visited pages in a semantic tree to guide later decisions and recovery.

entry.title: WikiHow Task Set
entry.summary: A Mobile-Env task set for evaluating navigation in the WikiHow app, with supplementary tasks across Android apps. It provides task definitions and rewritten instructions.

entry.title: GUI-Vid
entry.summary: GUI-Vid is a released video language model retrained on GUI-World for understanding graphical interfaces in video.

entry.title: NAIL-Group/ClawBenchV1Trace
entry.summary: ClawBench V1 Traces releases browser-agent run records with screen video, actions, network traffic and agent messages for replay, debugging and regrading.

entry.title: Obscura
entry.summary: Obscura is a Rust headless browser for agent automation. It runs JavaScript, exposes the Chrome DevTools Protocol and supports screenshots and browser automation tools.

entry.title: Qwen-CUA
entry.summary: Qwen-CUA is a screenshot-based computer-use model that generates grounded keyboard and mouse actions. Its release includes weights and a browser reference runtime.

entry.title: RICO-Screen2Words
entry.summary: RICO-Screen2Words pairs Android app screenshots with human screen summaries, app metadata and view hierarchies for mobile interface understanding.

entry.title: agent-qa
entry.summary: QA agent for browser and mobile apps that executes actions through Playwright and Appium, verifies steps, and records runs. Its publisher reports completing all AndroidWorld tasks.

entry.title: FinalRun
entry.summary: Android UI agent that prunes interface trees, waits for stable screens, feeds action failures back into its decisions, and takes fresh screenshots before grounding actions.

entry.title: GTA1-7B
entry.summary: Released GUI grounding checkpoint trained with reinforcement learning to predict click coordinates from screenshots and instructions, with inference examples and reported benchmark results.

entry.title: Browser Operator
entry.summary: Browser Operator is Opera's preview browser agent for carrying out natural-language browsing tasks while showing its steps and allowing user takeover.

entry.title: Browser Run
entry.summary: Browser Run hosts headless Chrome sessions for browser automation and agent browsing, with Playwright, Puppeteer, CDP and MCP integration options.

entry.title: GUITestBench
entry.summary: GUITestBench evaluates Android agents on multistep app defect discovery, using navigation and triggering checks alongside a judge model.

entry.title: hai-agents
entry.summary: hai-agents is a Python SDK and CLI for launching browser and desktop agents through H Company's Agents API and monitoring their sessions.

entry.title: scrcpy
entry.summary: scrcpy mirrors Android devices and lets users control them with a computer keyboard and mouse over USB or TCP/IP on Linux, Windows and macOS.

entry.title: STEVE-R1-7B-SFT
entry.summary: STEVE-R1-7B-SFT is a released computer-use checkpoint trained with step-verified data for desktop agent tasks and evaluated on Windows and Ubuntu environments.

entry.title: Surfer 2
entry.summary: Surfer 2 is a computer-use agent for desktop, web and mobile tasks. Its orchestrator assigns subtasks while components handle visual grounding and execution.

entry.title: cua-s1-forms
entry.summary: A 706,048-parameter checkpoint that scores candidate actions for GUI form fields in parallel. It is released as safetensors weights with a configuration file.

entry.title: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-FP8
entry.summary: An FP8 checkpoint in the Holo3.1 vision-language model family for computer-use agents. The card describes web, desktop and mobile tasks and links to deployment guidance.

entry.title: Kimi-VL-A3B-Thinking-2506
entry.summary: A multimodal reasoning model with released weights and high-resolution image input. Its authors report GUI grounding evaluations on ScreenSpot-Pro, ScreenSpot-V2 and OSWorld-G.

entry.title: RICO-ScreenQA-Short
entry.summary: A screen question-answering dataset based on RICO interface images, pairing questions with machine-generated short answers. It provides train, validation and test splits.

entry.title: Browserless
entry.summary: Browserless runs headless browsers as a Docker service for Puppeteer and Playwright scripts, with session concurrency controls and a live debugging view.

entry.title: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-NVFP4
entry.summary: Holo-3.1-35B-A3B-NVFP4 is a quantized computer-use vision-language checkpoint for web, desktop and mobile tasks, with function-calling support.

entry.title: MultimodalWebSurfer
entry.summary: MultimodalWebSurfer operates a Chromium browser through Playwright, using marked screenshots and a multimodal model to choose actions on web pages.
